after.existential_text:
Existential 1 =
?Goal :
  [a : nat
   b : nat
   c : nat
   n : R
   Hn : 0 < n
   Hn1 : n <> 1
   Ha : (1 < a)%nat
   Hb : (1 < b)%nat
   Hc : (1 < c)%nat
   Heq :
     Rpower (n * Rpower (n * Rpower n (/ INR c)) (/ INR b)) (/ INR a) =
     Rpower n (25 / 36)
   Hpc : 0 < Rpower n (/ INR c)
   Hpb : 0 < n * Rpower (n * Rpower n (/ INR c)) (/ INR b)
   Hpa : 0 < Rpower (n * Rpower (n * Rpower n (/ INR c)) (/ INR b)) (/ INR a)
   Hlog :
     / INR a * (ln n + ln (Rpower (n * Rpower n (/ INR c)) (/ INR b))) =
     25 / 36 * ln n
   Hrb : 0 < Rpower (n * Rpower n (/ INR c)) (/ INR b)
  |- b = 3%nat]
